pages.title: About Orbital Kitchens
pages.text: Orbital Kitchens runs shared commercial kitchens that restaurants rent to serve delivery orders. Founded in 2020 in Austin, the company operates 26 kitchens in 7 cities.

pages.title: Orbital Kitchens raises $22M
pages.text: Austin, June 2024. Orbital Kitchens raised $22 million in a Series A round led by Redwood Table Capital to open kitchens in Phoenix and Atlanta. Founder Luis Ortega said the company has been operating at positive margins in its three oldest kitchens.

pages.title: Orbital Kitchens reviews
pages.text: Orbital Kitchens has a 3.1 out of 5 rating from 88 employee reviews. Reviewers say the work is steady but pay is below the local average, and managers change often.

distractor.title: Orbital Kitchen Supply
distractor.text: A restaurant equipment dealer in Ohio. Unrelated.
